rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization annual rent increase limit
rules.requirement: Landlords may raise rent only once a year by no more than the lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change. The maximum allowable increase for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 is 2.87%.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change; 2.87% for 9/1/2026–8/31/2027
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; the page does not state the coverage details.
rules.penalty: Tenants may file a petition to contest increases above the maximum allowable rent increase.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.conflict_note: The page gives no official code citation, coverage conditions or exemptions. The 2.87% figure applies to the period 9/1/2026–8/31/2027.

rules.title: Santa Ana just cause eviction requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as nonpayment of rent, lease violation, or owner move-in.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance; the page does not state the coverage details.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you.

rules.title: Santa Ana relocation assistance for certain evictions
rules.requirement: When a landlord evicts a tenant for certain reasons, the landlord may be required to help pay the tenant's moving costs.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted for certain (unspecified) reasons under the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to evictions for certain reasons that the page does not specify.
